## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. [Method](../method.md)

<pre>
source                                    results  share of the score
<a name="decision-index-public-041"></a><a href="https://huggingface.co/datasets/multimodalart/decision-index-leaderboard/blob/ce1e2f1cdd5792b88827bae406057a215d3b0784/benchmarks.parquet">Decision Index 0.4.1 public suite (lab)</a>        42   92% ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇
<a name="decision-index-vision-04"></a><a href="https://huggingface.co/datasets/multimodalart/decision-index-vision-leaderboard/blob/7b4f33ec85120700f8daed7381b0b54542315811/benchmarks.parquet">Decision Index Vision 0.4 public suite …</a>       11    8% ▇
prior: pull toward the middle                        0% ▇
weighted average                                   = 33.2
